campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Every campaign your organisation owns, with the pool it commits and the content it has received.
campaigns.created: Draft created with the approved defaults.
campaigns.createFailed: The draft could not be created.
campaigns.emptyDescription: A new campaign starts as a draft with the approved defaults, which you can change before publishing.
campaigns.draftBrief: Describe the product, what the content must show, which assets creators may use and what is only a suggestion.
campaigns.notFoundDescription: This campaign does not belong to your organisation in the demo, or the link is wrong.

editor.title: Campaign configuration
editor.subtitle: Every value here is what creators read before they post. Amounts are in Malaysian ringgit and stored to the sen.
editor.fieldTitleHint: Creators see this in the public catalogue.
editor.fieldBriefHint: What the content must show, which assets may be used, and what is only a suggestion. A suggestion cannot become a reason to refuse payment.
editor.fieldPlatformsHint: Only platforms whose data access is verified can be offered.
editor.fieldLanguagesHint: The language of the content, separate from the interface language.
editor.fieldPoolHint: Total reward for this campaign. Funding is arranged outside this demo; entering an amount is not funding.
editor.fieldRateHint: Qualified views are verified against these rules. They are not raw plays, unique people, orders or sales.
editor.fieldMinClaimHint: The smallest new amount one claim can be. It is not a wallet withdrawal threshold.
editor.fieldThresholdHint: Leave empty for no extra threshold. When set, both the threshold and the minimum claim must be met.
editor.fieldCapHint: Cumulative ceiling for one post in this campaign. Claiming in parts does not reset it.
editor.fieldSubmissionWindowHint: Days after publishing during which links are accepted. A link accepted on the last day still gets its full metering window.
editor.fieldMeteringHint: Days counted from the moment a link is accepted. Views before acceptance never count.
editor.fieldGraceHint: Calendar days after metering ends during which a claim can still be filed.
editor.fieldRetentionHint: Days after publishing. The real end is the later of this, the claim deadline, any open case and any confirmed amount still to be sent.
editor.fieldCrossPlatformRule: On: each platform's post carries its own cap. Off: the same content is meant to share one cap across platforms. The same post id is never counted twice inside one campaign.
editor.fieldCrossPlatformNotSimulated: This switch records your permission only. The prototype identifies a submission by campaign, platform and post id and keeps no content identity, so it cannot tell one video re-posted on two platforms from two different videos: either way every accepted post is capped on its own. Shared-cap grouping is not simulated in M1.
editor.fieldRegionHint: Per-region billing needs verified per-region measurement first. An audience requirement is not the same fact as where a view happened.
editor.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved.
editor.readOnlyTitle: This campaign is not a draft
editor.readOnlyDescription: Published rules are not edited in this prototype: a submission keeps the rule version it joined under, so a change would need a new version. The values below are read-only.
editor.keyboardHint: Tab moves between fields. Enter saves the draft.
editor.errorMoney: Enter an amount in ringgit with at most two decimals, for example 2000.00.
editor.errorMoneyPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
editor.errorDays: Enter a whole number of days greater than zero.
editor.errorThreshold: Enter a whole number of qualified views greater than zero, or leave it empty.
editor.errorMinAboveCap: Minimum claim cannot exceed the per-submission cap
editor.errorLanguages: Choose at least one content language.
editor.errorSummary: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
editor.capExplainTitle: The cap is reached at this threshold
editor.capExplain: At {views} qualified views the reward is capped at {amount}.
editor.capExplainNote: This configuration is allowed. Reaching the threshold does not raise the cap, so state the ceiling in the brief.
editor.defaultsDescription: A new draft starts from the approved defaults: pool {pool}, {rate}, minimum claim {min}, cap {cap} per submission, {submissionDays} days of submissions, {meteringDays} days of metering, {graceDays} calendar days of claim grace and {retentionDays} days of retention.

preview.title: Readiness check
preview.subtitle: What creators will read, the calendar it produces, and what is still missing before this can be published.
preview.rulesTitle: Rules as creators will see them
preview.rulesNote: This is the same rule sheet the public campaign page renders.
preview.calendarProjected: Projected from the simulated clock. The real dates are recorded when the campaign is published.
preview.calMeteringValue: {days} days from the moment the link is accepted
preview.calRetentionValue: {days} days after publishing, extended by open cases and confirmed amounts
preview.calExample: A link accepted on {accepted} stops metering on {meteringEnd} and can be claimed until {claimDeadline}.
preview.readinessHint: The demo tools panel and the operations readiness page record these. Entering a pool amount is not funding.
preview.publishHint: Publishing makes the campaign public in this browser and notifies your organisation. Nothing is charged and no email is sent.
preview.blockedInvalid: Publishing is blocked: the configuration has errors. Fix them in the editor.
preview.blockedNotDraft: Only a draft can be published. This campaign is already {status}.
preview.missingDataSource: data source readiness is not recorded
preview.published: Published. The campaign is now in the public catalogue.

detail.budgetNote: Reserved is not paid. A reservation holds an amount for one claim; it becomes confirmed unpaid only after both reviews pass, and paid only once the simulated provider confirms the funds are available.
detail.claimsNote: Claim status is a separate fact from the content decision and from the payout.
detail.reportNote: Confirmed unpaid is an obligation that exists; paid means the funds are available in the simulated provider account. They are never merged.
detail.closureTail: Unconfirmed amounts below the minimum claim
detail.closureTailNote: These tails are not paid by default. They are disclosed here in advance, and they never touch an amount that is already confirmed.
detail.closureNotSettledNote: Open appeals, claims in progress, confirmed unpaid amounts or unresolved payouts are still outstanding, so this campaign cannot be shown as fully settled.
detail.closureSettledNote: No open appeal, no claim in progress, nothing confirmed unpaid and no unresolved payout.
detail.closureRefundNote: There is no automatic refund in this prototype; the unused pool and the amounts still owed are kept apart.
detail.pauseDescription: New submissions stop. Links already accepted keep metering and existing claims keep the rules they joined under.
detail.resumeDescription: Submissions open again, unless the submission window has already ended.
detail.closeSubmissionsDescription: New links are refused from now on. A link accepted today still gets its full metering window.
detail.closeCampaignDescription: Closing does not settle open appeals, claims in progress or confirmed unpaid amounts, and it does not refund the unused pool.
detail.reasonStored: The reason is stored with this decision and shown in the campaign history.
detail.notPublished: This campaign is still a draft, so it has no public page yet.

review.title: Content review
review.subtitle: Decide whether the content follows the rules the creator joined under. A content decision is not a payment and confirms no amount.
review.creator: Creator
review.postLinkAction: Open the post (opens a new tab)
review.contentPending: No decision has been recorded yet.
review.approveDescription: The content follows the rules. This records a content approval only: it is not a payment, and it does not confirm any amount.
review.rejectDescription: Write the reason the creator will read. A rejection keeps any reservation until the appeal window closes; it does not return the amount to the pool immediately.
review.meteringDescription: Operations verify the qualified views. You cannot change this, and a content approval on its own never confirms an amount.
review.meteringNoClaim: No claim has been filed for this submission yet, so there is no metering review.
review.rewardNote: These numbers come from the same engine reading the creator and operations see.
review.notFoundDescription: This submission does not belong to your organisation in the demo, or the link is wrong.
review.windowNote: The same dates the creator and operations read. Nothing here is editable after publishing.
review.windowMeteringEndsNote: Views recorded after this moment do not count towards the reward.
review.windowEffectiveDeadlineNote: Later than the published one only when an extension was granted.
review.retentionReasonPublished: The published retention period after the campaign went live.
review.retentionReasonClaimDeadline: The claim deadline in force runs later than the published retention.
review.retentionReasonCaseResolved: The last claim or appeal on this post was resolved later than the published retention period.
review.retentionReasonSettlement: The confirmed payment for this post completed later than the published retention period.
review.retentionReasonOpenCases: A submitted claim or appeal is still open, so no end date exists yet.
review.retentionReasonConfirmedUnpaid: A confirmed amount has not been paid yet, so no end date exists yet.
review.extensionReasonDataOutage: The source was unreadable while the window and grace were running.
review.extensionReasonPendingCase: An open claim or appeal blocked a new claim on this post.
review.extensionNote: An extension gives the published grace again from the moment the block cleared. The metering window is not re-opened and queue times are not back-dated.

submissions.title: Submissions
submissions.subtitle: Content submitted to your campaigns. Content review is yours; metering review belongs to operations.
submissions.emptyDescription: When a creator submits a link to one of your campaigns it appears here for content review.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Metering and money per campaign. The four amounts always add up to that campaign's pool.
